items.title: Goldman Sachs, BofA Among 21 Banks Planning Joint Dollar Stablecoin Launch
items.summary: The bank-led consortium wants a U.S. dollar token live by the first half of 2027, with a euro version queued up next.

items.title: Miners And More Lead Slew Of Stocks To Watch — With This Line In Focus
items.summary: Miners like Southern Copper and Newmont lead this screen of stocks to watch in or near buy range alongside UBS, Garmin and more.

items.title: Large U.S. banks face rising G-SIB buffers and tighter excess capital: GS
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs believes the largest U.S. banks are likely to moderate capital deployment as regulatory buffers rise for a third consecutive year and excess capital levels shrink.

items.title: Why Friday’s Jobs Report Could Surprise the Fed and Shock Markets
items.summary: The Federal Reserve is increasingly expected to raise interest rates in September, but signs of labor-market softness are putting new focus on Friday’s jobs report.

items.title: Affirm Rallies 6% on $104 Price Target From BofA, Sezzle Climbs 4%, PayPal Rises 3%
items.summary: Bank of America dropped a fresh price target on Affirm just as yields began to ease, and the combination sent buy-now-pay-later stocks racing ahead of a sleepy broad market. Whether the rally holds depends on a credit question Levchin himself flagged on live television.

items.title: Have Bonds Killed the Stock Market Rally? Maybe Not.
items.summary: The S&P 500 has risen about 2.6% since late June despite a global bond market selloff that pushed 10-year Treasury yields to a high of 4.815%.

items.title: Banks Just Hijacked Crypto’s Original Promise: The Revolution Against Wall Street Is Now Owned by Wall Street
items.summary: The institutions that crypto was built to destroy are now racing to control its most important financial primitive. What happens to the rebellion when the banks become the infrastructure?

items.title: Will Kinexys Fuel JPMorgan's Next Leg of Payments Growth?
items.summary: JPM's Kinexys is gaining traction as blockchain settlement speeds fund transfers and supports deeper client ties and Payments growth.
